name: studyflow
description: An all-in-one organizer for IB Diploma Programme students.
comment: The site itself still has no dependencies — index.html, the app/ folder and
everything a browser downloads is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no
bundler, no framework and no CDN.
This one dependency belongs to the accounts backend in netlify/functions/,
which runs on the server and never reaches a browser. Netlify installs it
